title: Python Developer Intern
description:
Based on current job postings across India for **Python/Django Interns**, companies looking to hire emerging developers typically require a specific mix of core programming skills, backend familiarity, and practical tools.

To help you design a curriculum that gets your students hired or to write an attractive job description to hire one yourself, here is what the industry actually expects from a Python/Django intern.

Technical Skills RequiredCore Python Programming

Interns aren't expected to know everything about architecture, but they must be completely comfortable with writing clean, functional Python.

* **Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP):** Solid grip on classes, inheritance, and functions.
* **Data Structures:** Mastery over lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets, and basic algorithms.
* **Virtual Environments:** Ability to use venv or virtualenv to manage package dependencies cleanly.

Django \& Backend Web Development

* **MVT Architecture:** Understanding Model\-View\-Template pattern and how data flows through a Django app.
* **Django ORM \& Databases:** Ability to write database queries using Python code instead of raw SQL, write migrations (makemigrations, migrate), and link tables (One\-to\-Many, Many\-to\-Many).
* **Django REST Framework (DRF):** Almost every Python web internship demands basic knowledge of REST APIs. Interns should know how to use **Serializers**, **APIViews/ViewSets**, and handle JSON data.
* **Authentication \& Security:** Familiarity with user login/registration flows, JWT (JSON Web Tokens), or session\-based authentication.

Essential Tools \& Infrastructure

* **Version Control (Git/GitHub):** The absolute \#1 requirement. Knowing how to branch, commit, push, and create pull requests without breaking the codebase.
* **Databases:** Hands\-on experience with **PostgreSQL** or **MySQL** (moving beyond just default local SQLite).
* **API Testing Tools:** Ability to test endpoints independently using **Postman** or **cURL**.

Soft Skills \& Daily Responsibilities

When companies hire Python/Django interns, their typical daily tasks include:

* **Writing \& Debugging Code:** Fixing small bugs in existing backend services or writing minor helper scripts.
* **API Integration:** Connecting the backend with third\-party APIs (like payment gateways, SMS providers, or AI models).
* **Collaborating with Frontend:** Working alongside React/Flutter developers by delivering clean JSON endpoints for them to consume.
* **Documentation:** Writing clear API docs and maintaining clean README.md files.

What Makes an Intern Stand Out (Bonus Skills)

If a student wants to comfortably clear interviews at tech hubs like Infopark or Bangalore, having any of these gives an immediate edge over freshers:

* **Basic Cloud/Deployment:** Knowing how to deploy an app to a live server (VPS like Ubuntu/DigitalOcean, Render, or AWS EC2\).
* **Docker Basics:** Understanding how to containerize a Django app.
* **AI/ML Integration:** Since many Python backends power AI tools, basic exposure to integrating OpenAI/LLM APIs into a Django backend is highly valued right now.

Pay: From ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Benefits Operations Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

**HR Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations**
=====================================================


**Role Overview**
-----------------


As an HR Manager, you will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to performance management, payroll coordination, employee engagement, compliance, and exit formalities.  

This is a hands\-on role where you will work closely with management to build strong HR processes, foster a positive work culture, and support the company's growth by attracting, developing, and retaining the right talent.  

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in recruitment, HR operations, employee relations, and compliance within a fast\-paced organisation.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment**


* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment across all departments, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, shortlisting, offer negotiations, and onboarding.
* Coordinate with recruitment consultants, job portals, and referral networks to build a strong talent pipeline.
* Schedule interviews with department heads and ensure a seamless hiring experience

### **Employee Lifecycle Management**


* Manage employee onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
* Ensure timely issuance of appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, warning letters, and experience certificates.

### **HR Operations \& Compliance**


* Implement and maintain HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and company guidelines.
* Manage attendance, leave records, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, and employee documentation.
* Coordinate with finance and external consultants for payroll processing and statutory requirements, including PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and other applicable compliance requirements.

### **Performance Management \& Employee Engagement**


* Coordinate probation reviews, performance appraisals, KRAs/KPIs, and employee development initiatives.
* Organise training sessions, team\-building activities, employee engagement programs, and recognition initiatives.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and performance\-driven work culture while acting as the primary HR point of contact for employees.

### **HR Systems \& Administration**


* Maintain HRMS, employee databases, attendance systems, and HR reports.
* Prepare monthly HR MIS, recruitment reports, attrition reports, and manpower updates.
* Continuously improve HR processes and recommend initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------


### **Experience**


* 3–6 years of experience in Human Resources with exposure to recruitment and HR operations.
* Experience in Real Estate, Consulting, BFSI, Startups, or Service Industries will be preferred.
* Experience handling end\-to\-end employee lifecycle management in a growing organisation is an added advantage.

title: Closing Manager - Real Estate
description:
**Closing Manager – Real Estate Sales**
=======================================


**Empowering Real Estate Success Through Strategy, Sales \& Execution**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------


**Position: Closing Manager**
-----------------------------


### **Role Overview**


As a Closing Manager, you will be responsible for converting qualified prospects into successful property bookings. You will represent premium real estate projects, interact with serious homebuyers and investors, conduct project presentations, and guide customers throughout the purchase journey.


This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in a target\-driven environment, enjoy building client relationships, and possess a strong ability to negotiate and close deals.


Your contribution will directly impact project success and revenue growth.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Sales \& Client Relationship Management**


* Engage with prospective buyers generated through walk\-ins, digital campaigns, channel partners, referrals, and inbound enquiries.
* Understand customer requirements, budgets, and investment objectives.
* Build trust and long\-term relationships with potential buyers.
* Maintain a professional and consultative sales approach throughout the customer journey.

### **Property Presentations \& Site Visits**


* Conduct project presentations and site visits for prospective clients.
* Explain project specifications, amenities, location advantages, floor plans, pricing structures, payment plans, and investment benefits.
* Effectively communicate the project's unique selling propositions (USPs).

### **Deal Closure \& Revenue Generation**


* Manage the complete sales cycle from enquiry generation to booking confirmation.
* Handle negotiations, objections, and customer concerns confidently.
* Create urgency and drive timely decision\-making.
* Achieve and exceed assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.

### **Documentation \& Coordination**


* Coordinate with sourcing teams, channel partners, CRM teams, and back\-office departments to ensure smooth transaction processing.
* Assist customers with booking procedures, documentation, and payment schedules.
* Ensure compliance with all required documentation and company processes.

### **CRM Management \& Reporting**


* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and follow\-ups in CRM software.
* Track lead status and sales pipeline movement.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.

### **Market Intelligence**


* Stay updated on Mumbai real estate trends, competitor projects, pricing movements, and customer preferences.
* Share market insights that can help improve sales strategies and customer engagement.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------


### **Experience**


* Minimum 2 years of experience in real estate sales, BFSI, or automobile sales.
* Senior\-level opportunities available for experienced professionals with strong industry networks.
* Senior\-level opportunities available for candidates with extensive closing experience and strong sales achievements.
* Prior experience in real estate projects is preferred.

### **Skills Required**


* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent negotiation and persuasion abilities.
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong objection\-handling and relationship\-building skills.
* Customer\-focused mindset with high professionalism.
* CRM proficiency and disciplined follow\-up management.

### **Educational Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Real Estate, or related fields.
* MBA or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage.

description:
**Talent Sourcing \& Workforce DevelopmentIndustrial Recruitment \| Campus Relations \| Skill Development \| Contractor Development \| Workforce Planning**

**Company:** JC Global  
**Base Location:** Gummidipoondi \-Chennai / Ganeshapuram\-Coimbatore  
**Travel Requirement:** Extensive travel across India, including Tamil Nadu, Odisha, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Kerala, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Assam, and other states as required.

About JC Global

JC Global is one of India's fastest\-growing Circular Economy companies engaged in manufacturing premium recycled polymer granules and Polymer Pyrolysis Oil (PPO). With expanding manufacturing facilities across Chennai and Coimbatore, the company is committed to building a skilled, stable, and safety\-conscious workforce capable of supporting advanced recycling technologies.

We are seeking a highly energetic **Talent Sourcing \& Workforce Development Manager** to build a sustainable talent pipeline for plant operations by partnering with technical institutions, skill development organizations, government bodies, and verified labour contractors across India.

Position Summary

The Talent Sourcing \& Workforce Development Manager will be responsible for ensuring uninterrupted manpower availability for JC Global's manufacturing plants by developing long\-term recruitment partnerships with ITIs, CIPETs, Polytechnics, Government Skill Development Centres, NSDC\-affiliated institutions, apprenticeship providers, and verified manpower contractors.

The primary objective is to create a **continuous talent pipeline** of employees who are committed to long\-term careers in the recycling and manufacturing industry.

To ensure **100% manpower availability** across all manufacturing units by building sustainable recruitment channels, institutional partnerships, and contractor networks while reducing employee attrition and improving workforce quality.

The ideal candidate should be:

* Highly self\-driven and field\-oriented.
* Passionate about building long\-term talent pipelines.
* Comfortable with extensive travel across India.
* Excellent at networking and relationship building.
* Strong negotiator and recruiter.
* Highly organized with strong follow\-up skills.
* Results\-oriented and proactive in solving manpower challenges.

The role will be evaluated based on measurable workforce outcomes:

* Maintain **100% manpower availability** for all plants.
* Establish **25–50 active institutional partnerships** (ITI, CIPET, Polytechnic, Skill Centres) across India.

* Ensure **90%\+ joining ratio** for selected candidates.
* Achieve **low early attrition** (within the first six months) through quality hiring.
* Build and maintain a database of **1,000\+ pre\-screened candidates** for critical manufacturing roles.
* Conduct **monthly campus drives and recruitment events**.
* Increase apprenticeship hiring and conversion to full\-time employment.
* Ensure all contractor documentation and compliance records are current and audit\-ready.
* Reduce recruitment turnaround time and cost per hire while maintaining workforce quality.

Salary as per industry Standard

Experience 5 Years

Pay: From ₹30,000\.00 per month

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. * Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**

**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most\-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**

**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**Position:** Talent Acquisition Specialist
  

**Location:** Mumbai (Hybrid)
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, Regular


### **About the Role**

We are seeking a driven and experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist to lead end\-to\-end hiring for our technology product organization, supporting talent needs across **India and the MEA (Middle East \& Africa) region** . This role requires a proactive recruiter who can partner closely with hiring managers, understand complex technical requirements, and deliver high\-quality talent efficiently across multiple geographies.


The ideal candidate brings strong sourcing expertise, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a solid understanding of regional hiring dynamics. You will play a critical role in building diverse, high\-performing teams while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience.


### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers across India and MEA to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from requisition to offer closure across multiple geographies
* Source and attract top talent through multiple channels including job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and industry networks
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across India and MEA markets
* Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates using structured and competency\-based assessment methods
* Provide informed recommendations and market insights to hiring managers
* Drive offer discussions, negotiate compensation, and ensure timely closures
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience across all touchpoints
* Maintain accurate records in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and candidate databases
* Stay updated on talent trends, compensation benchmarks, and hiring practices across India and MEA
* Continuously improve recruitment processes and drive operational excellence
* Promote fair, unbiased hiring practices aligned with Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Wellbeing commitments

### **Essential Skills \& Capabilities**

* Proven experience in Talent Acquisition or similar roles
* Strong expertise in sourcing and networking, particularly via LinkedIn and digital platforms
* Demonstrated experience hiring across a **diverse range of roles** , including Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, Project Managers, Sales Engineers, and related functions
* Experience hiring across India and/or international regions (MEA exposure is a plus)
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Solid understanding of recruitment processes, hiring metrics, and labor laws
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Strong interviewing skills including behavioral and competency\-based techniques
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
* High attention to detail and strong confidentiality standards
* Effective negotiation and influencing skills

### **Experience Required**

* 6\+ years of end\-to\-end Talent Acquisition experience within a technology product organization
* Proven experience in hiring/sourcing/recruiting for roles such as **Energy Management Software specialists, Software Engineers, Electrical Engineers, and Engineering Sales specialists**
* Experience hiring for technical and/or corporate roles in a global environment
* Experience supporting hiring across India and exposure to MEA markets preferred
* Prior experience working within a People/HR team, with understanding of HR policies and the employee lifecycle

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently delivering high\-quality hires across India and MEA within timelines
* Building strong partnerships with hiring managers and regional stakeholders
* Demonstrating strong understanding of regional talent markets
* Creating a best\-in\-class candidate experience
* Contributing to a diverse and inclusive workforce

**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**

**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**

**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 11 July 2026 **Title: Early Careers Global Coordinator and Recruiter \- UK and India**

**Department:** **Early Careers Recruitment (HR \- CPO)**

**Location: Gurgaon, India**

  

We're proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years, to more than 2\.56 million customers globally. From more than 25 locations around the world, with $619 billion in total assets, we provide investment services and retirement expertise to everyone from central banks to private individuals. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Early Careers Recruitment team and feel like you're part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. And across our organisation, we foster a welcoming, caring and inclusive culture where people feel respected, trusted and able to be themselves. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

  



As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Early Careers Recruitment is part of the Chief People Office and works closely with business leaders, programme management, Talent Acquisition, HR and external partners to attract, assess and hire bright minds and diverse perspectives into Fidelity International. We recruit and engage future talent across graduate, intern, apprentice, insight and pipeline programmes, helping individuals take the first steps in their professional journeys while building the skills and potential our business needs for the future. In the UK, much of the work supports Investment Management early careers hiring; in India, the role will also support campus hiring for technology talent.


The team acts as a brand ambassador for Fidelity International and owns the candidate experience across early careers hiring. We combine relationship\-led attraction, inclusive assessment, data\-driven decision making and strong operational delivery to ensure our programmes are compelling, consistent, scalable and fair.

**About your role**


You will support early careers recruitment delivery across the UK and India, working closely with colleagues in both regions. Around 60% of the role will support UK early careers coordination and administration, with a focus on Investment Management, Distribution and FIL Platforms hiring. Around 40% will support India early careers hiring, primarily across technology roles, through campus recruitment delivery, university relationship management, candidate engagement and junior recruiter activity.


This role would suit someone who is highly organised, accurate, accountable and proactive, with strong English communication skills and the confidence to represent Fidelity International with candidates, universities and internal stakeholders. Working closely with Early Careers colleagues, HR, business stakeholders and external partners, you will:


UK Responsibilities:

* Support UK early careers recruitment coordination across graduate, intern, apprentice and pipeline programmes, including interview scheduling, assessment centre logistics, candidate communications, inbox management and tracker updates.
* Maintain accurate candidate, vacancy and process data in Oleeo and Workday, recruitment trackers and dashboards, supporting reporting, audit readiness and timely decision making.
* Support selection and assessment administration, including candidate progression, assessor communications, feedback collation, offer process support and joining handover.
* Coordinate candidate travel and expense processes for assessment centres, interviews and events, ensuring clear communication, accurate records and timely follow\-up.
* Support early careers onboarding administration, helping candidates and new joiners move smoothly from offer acceptance through to joining.

  

India responsibilities:

* Support India early careers hiring, primarily across technology roles, through role posting, candidate screening, shortlisting support, interview coordination, candidate management and follow\-up.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with selected universities, colleges, placement teams and student groups in India, supporting campus hiring plans and long\-term early careers talent pipelines.
* Play an active role in on\-campus recruitment events in India, coordinating interview days, assessment activity, candidate flow, stakeholder logistics and post\-event follow\-up.
* Help deliver a positive, inclusive and well\-organised experience for students, candidates, assessors and business stakeholders throughout the India campus hiring process..

  

Shared responsibilities:

* Coordinate and support early careers events, insight activities, campus engagement and virtual sessions, ensuring logistics, communications, materials and follow\-up actions are well managed.
* Support recruitment administration and operations activity, including process documentation, candidate checklists, purchase order or invoice support where required, and accurate records management.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across the UK, India and wider global Early Careers team, contributing to consistent processes, shared ways of working and practical improvements.
* Manage high volumes of work during peak recruitment periods, prioritising effectively while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness and strong service standards.

**About you**

* You will have experience in recruitment coordination, HR coordination, talent acquisition operations or a similar role, ideally with exposure to early careers, campus hiring or high\-volume recruitment.
* You will be highly organised and conscientious, with excellent attention to detail, strong follow\-through and the ability to meet deadlines during busy periods.
* You will be accountable and proactive, taking ownership of your tasks and looking for ways to support colleagues and improve the candidate or stakeholder experience.
* You will have strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally and empathetically with candidates, colleagues and stakeholders across locations.
* You will be comfortable managing candidate queries and sensitive candidate interactions, showing patience, care and good judgement in your responses.
* You will be collaborative and team\-oriented, working closely with colleagues in both the UK and India.
* You will be comfortable building relationships with universities, colleges, placement teams, student groups and candidates, representing Fidelity International professionally in a campus environment.
* You will be comfortable using applicant tracking systems, recruitment trackers and Microsoft Office tools; experience supporting campus hiring, assessment centres, candidate screening, onboarding or offer administration would be useful..

 **Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.


For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

**As an international financial services organisation, we are in\-scope of international regulations in the way that we carry out our work. This position is involved in work that is regulated by the FCA and/or the PRA and their Individual Conduct Rules (COCON) apply to it, along with any other regulation. We provide training on COCON and how it affects our employees. More information about COCON can be found in the Employment** **Handbook.**

* Maintain employee records and digital personnel files.
* Update and maintain HRMS with complete employee information.
* Manage probation confirmations and probation tracking.
* Issue employment letters and HR\-related documentation.
* Maintain leave and attendance records as required.
* Ensure employee information remains accurate and up to date.


 Compliance Administration
   

  

* Ensure statutory and company documentation is maintained.
* Maintain employee compliance records.
* Track document expirations and renewals where applicable.
* Support HR audits by maintaining organized documentation.
* Ensure adherence to internal HR policies and processes.


 Coordination

* Ensure cross\-functional readiness before every employee joining.
* Coordinate onboarding schedules across multiple departments.
* Track onboarding progress and resolve operational bottlenecks.

* Excellent organizational skills.

* Strong documentation and record management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

* Process\-oriented mindset.

title: Power2Her Associate
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

About the Programme


Power2Her is HSBC India Bank’s first\-ever formal returnship programme that enables promising women professionals to return to work after a career break. Launched in 2021, it is a key initiative to augment the potential of women colleagues looking to restart their career. It is also an opportunity to attract great talent and strengthen future leadership pipeline. This is a structured 6\-month journey to build the mindset and skills to integrate back into work. The participants will be entitled to a standard monthly stipend for the duration of the program. Power2Her (P2H) has played a pivotal role in infusing diversity at mid to junior levels within the bank. We have deployed 56% participants into full time roles across businesses and functions.


Who are we looking for?


If you are looking to return back to work and fulfil the criteria below then please apply by clicking the button below and send us your resume. If selected, we will be in contact within the next 2 weeks to confirm your participation and further details. If it is not for you, but you do know someone that could be interested then please do forward this on and ask them to apply!

* Minimum 5 years of professional full\-time experience
* Out of the workforce for a minimum of 6 months
* Open to opportunities for 6 months’ contract roles based in India
* Previous career history in one of the following areas: Wealth Management, Relationship Management, Service Orientation, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Business Banking, Trade Finance, Cash Management, Securities Services, Custody, Asset Management Sales/Service/Operations, Data Analytics, Compliance, Risk Management, Operations, Finance \& Accounting, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Business Support, Supply Chain and Procurement
* Eligible to work in India
* Must be available to attend all workshops and events related to the program


How will we support the returners?

* A well\-rounded 6 months Development Plan with structured interventions has been carefully designed to support the transition of returning candidates.
* The returners will be invited to join two curated workshops on ‘Reboot your Career \& Personal Brand’ and ‘Communicate with Confidence \& Empowered Accountability’ to support assimilate into our culture and be provided with a mentor to help navigate the eco\-system better.
* A sensitization workshop for Line Managers is organized to help create awareness on their role and aspired behaviors when managing this group.

  

Programme Features:

* P2H returners are hired across organization levels and do not have a Global Career Band
* P2H returners are hired basis business demand throughout the year
* P2H returners are entitled to 10 days Privilege Leaves that should be pre\-approved on email by the Line Manager during the 6\-month internship duration
* P2H returners are entitled to the Child\-care allowance as per policy (where required)
* P2H returners are encouraged to apply on all internal \& external jobs that are advertised basis relevance of skills from the day of joining
* P2H returners can be converted for a Full Time role on a real time basis if the returner has performed well and shows potential as per business hiring needs


Application \& Selection process for the Power2Her programme:

* To apply for the programme, please visit our website and apply
* Submit your profile by completing 7 self\-explanatory steps. Once the profile submission and e\-signature step is completed. A link to complete the psychometric assessment will appear. Please take your time to complete the assessment
* Profiles of candidates who have cleared the assessment will be shared with Hiring Managers for further evaluation
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews with respective business manager \& HR
* Pre\-Employment Vetting (PEV) checks will be initiated for the final selected candidate
* Employment contract for 6 months will be issued to the candidate with start \& end date post PEV checks completion which take about 2 weeks
* Induction invite will be sent with more details with the date of joining
* Experience Letter will be issued post 6 months’ program completion


Selection for Full time opportunities


Returners will be evaluated during the 6 months’ tenor. They will be evaluated for full\-time opportunities subject to performance and availability of suitable openings across businesses and functions. For more details on the programme, please reach out to rachna1\.mathur@hsbc.co.in

title: Senior HR Generalist
description:
**Who We Are**



Quickplay is a Content\-to\-Value Operating System for media and entertainment, connecting every stage of the content lifecycle—from ingest and enrichment to publishing and monetization—through a single, orchestrated AI system. We power video streaming for Tier\-1 operators, including Warner Bros. Discovery, TelevisaUnivision, Telekom Malaysia, Television New Zealand, and Gray Media.

  

Headquartered in Toronto with offices in Toronto, San Diego, and Chennai, Quickplay is the proven foundation that broadcasters, sports operators, streamers, and creators rely on to turn their catalog into revenue.

 **The Mission**



We are looking for you to drive new institutional capabilities and scale within our Chennai hub. This is one of the most leveraged roles on our People team—someone who will operate at the intersection of global talent strategy, local operational excellence, and organizational design. The role is intentionally split 50/50 between two halves: driving the future of our India operations and quarterbacking the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our Chennai team.

  

This is also an AI\-forward HR role. We don't want a traditional administrator; we expect this person to help us build out the People agent stack that handles the operational layer of HR—statutory compliance hygiene, documentation, data reporting, and foundational workflows—so that you and our leadership can spend your time on the work that actually moves the needle: talent judgment, high\-touch coaching, and cultural scaling. If you’re someone who sees AI as leverage rather than overhead and wants a hand in shaping how a modern, global HR org operates in India, you’ll have the autonomy to do that here.

 **What You’ll Own**



You will perform work with a high degree of latitude, handling complex issues and serving as the in\-country liaison. This is an individual contributor role. Your key responsibilities include:


* **HR Transformation \& AI:** Actively explore, implement, and leverage AI\-driven tools to streamline HR workflows, data analysis, and employee support. You are the custodian of a "frictionless" employee experience.
* **Strategic Global Collaboration:** Partner directly with the VP of People (located in North America) to bridge the gap between global strategy and local execution. You aren't just a link; you are the local expert who ensures our global initiatives land with impact. That includes proactively communicating and driving visibility.
* **Operational Excellence in the Fundational Stuff:** Own the foundational stuff \- from employee lifecycle for India, managing statutory reporting, and on\-the\-ground activities.
* **Local HR Partnership:** Provide consultative guidance and coaching to local managers and employees to ensure alignment with corporate policies and objectives. Partner with local vendors to bring meaningful educational experiences to Quickplayers.
* **Compliance \& Culture:** Provide consultative coaching to local managers to ensure our Chennai team remains high\-performing, inclusive, and deeply connected to Quickplay’s global culture, while giving oxygen to the local culture we want to amplify. Highly competitive Carrom tournaments are just the tip of the iceberg.

  


**Who You Are**

  

* **Experienced \& Context\-Aware:** You bring 8\-10 years of progressive experience, most recently as an HRBP or Senior Generalist, ideally in a high\-growth tech environment or in a global GCC.
* **An AI Experimenter:** You don't just use HRIS systems; you look for ways to optimize them. You are curious about how automation and LLMs can replace manual HR tasks. *Side Note:* We love Google and are a G Suite company.
* **A Cross\-Border Collaborator:** You are comfortable working across time zones, managing remote reporting lines, and driving strategic direction with minimal supervision.
* **High EQ / Low Ego:** You are a great teammate who understands that HR is about people, not just policies. You provide coaching that is both direct and empathetic.
* **Agile \& Autonomous:** You prioritize ruthlessly in fast\-paced environments and are comfortable "owning the room" when representing India’s interests to global leadership.

  


**Why Quickplay?**


* **High Leverage:** You aren't just a cog in the wheel; you are shaping the strategy for our entire India operation.
* **Innovation over Administration:** We encourage you to use AI and other creative avenues to make HR "smarter." If there’s a better, or more tech\-forward way to do it**,** bring your ideas to the table, and let’s try new things together.
* **Global Exposure:** Gain direct visibility with North American leadership, coordinate and drive global processes, while building a world\-class team in Chennai.

  


**Are you ready to build the future of HR at Quickplay? If you are a tech\-forward People pro who thrives on autonomy, let’s talk**

description:

Flutter Entertainment is the world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator **with 15\.9 million Average Monthly Players** worldwide and annual revenue of **$16\.4 billion** in 2025\. As a pioneering force in the industry, Flutter is at the forefront of technological innovation, offering seamless digital experiences to millions of customers worldwide. With a commitment to responsible gaming and a focus on customer\-first strategies, Flutter leverages its scale, diverse offerings, and data\-driven insights to deliver entertainment while ensuring the highest safety and compliance standards. Its dynamic approach to global growth has positioned Flutter as a dominant player in established and emerging markets, pushing the boundaries of the entertainment experience.


Flutter Entertainment is listed on both the **New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE).** We’re proud to be recognized by **TIME** as one of the **World’s Best Companies 2025** — a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  

Our ambition is to transform global gaming and betting to deliver long\-term growth and a positive, sustainable future for our sector. Together, we are **Changing the Game** .


**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**

Our office in the heart of **Hi\-Tech City** , Hyderabad, serves as **Flutter Entertainment’s Global Capability Center (GCC).** Now home to 1,000\+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data \& Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech \& Analytics.


We are committed to crafting impactful solutions for all our brands and divisions to power Flutter's incredible growth and global impact. Our portfolio of **world\-class brands, global scale, and challenger mindset** presents a powerful combination.


We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future and the **global and local scale to achieve them.**

**OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE**

The HR Operations Trainer is responsible for designing and delivering comprehensive training programs to enhance the capabilities of HR Operations, People Services, and related stakeholders. The role focuses on ensuring a consistent and high\-quality understanding of HR processes, policies, and systems across teams.


This position plays a critical role in driving operational excellence by continuously improving training content, methodologies, and learning effectiveness. It also supports compliance and process adherence through structured learning initiatives and effective knowledge management practices.


The HR Operations Trainer collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to identify capability gaps and implement targeted training interventions. Additionally, the role is responsible for monitoring training effectiveness through assessments, feedback, and performance metrics, ensuring continuous improvement and an enhanced employee and stakeholder experience through accurate and timely HR operational knowledge.


**KEY RESPOBSIBILITIES**

**Training Design \& Delivery**

* Design, develop and deliver engaging training programs for HR Operations and People Services teams (new joiners and existing staff).
* Deliver training through a mix of formats including virtual sessions, classroom training, workshops, and self\-paced learning.
* Tailor content to different audiences, including HR Operations, managers, and wider business stakeholders where required.

**HR Process \& Systems**

* Train teams on end\-to\-end HR operational processes (employee lifecycle, case management, data management, background screening).
* Support training on HR systems and tools (HCM, case management platform, knowledge bases).
* Ensure training materials reflect current policies, procedures, and system updates.
* Continuous Improvement
* Partner with HR Operations leaders, SMEs, and Transformation teams to identify training needs and capability gaps.
* Continuously review and improve training content based on feedback, metrics, and operational changes.
* Support change initiatives by developing training aligned to new processes, systems, or ways of working.

**Knowledge management**

* Create and maintain training documents and learning materials.
* Contribute to HR Knowledge bases and ensure learning content remains accurate and up to date.
* Promote best practice and consistency across HR Operations globally or regionally.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Core HR and Transformation to align training with business priorities.
* Act as a trusted partner to leaders and managers on capability development within HR Operations.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**

**Essential**

* Proven experience in HR Operations, People Services or HR Shared Services.
* Experience designing and delivering training, ideally within an HR or operational environment.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and employee lifecycle activities.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate complex processes into clear, practical learning content.

**Desirable**

* Experience supporting HR transformation or change initiatives.
* Exposure to global or regional HR operating models.
* Experience with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and case management tools.
* Formal training or learning \& development qualification.

**Qualifications:**

* Certification in Training \& Development, HR Operations, or Learning \& Development is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of HR operations processes, policies, and compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to create training materials, SOPs, process documents, and assessments.

**Experience:**

* Typically, 3–7 years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, or HR Service Delivery.
* Prior experience in conducting process training, onboarding, refresher sessions, and knowledge transfer activities.
* Hands\-on experience in areas such as:
* Employee lifecycle management
* HRIS systems
* Query handling and ticketing systems
* Experience in process improvement and quality initiatives is preferred.
* Exposure to global HR processes and stakeholder management is an advantage.
* Previous experience as a trainer, mentor, SME, or quality analyst is highly preferred.

**Measure of Success**

* Identify skill gaps through performance analysis and implement targeted coaching or refresher training programs.
* Support operational excellence by improving key performance indicators such as quality, productivity, SLA adherence, and customer/employee satisfaction.
* Partner effectively with Operations, Quality, and Process teams to enable continuous learning and capability development across the function.

title: S&C GN - TS&T – Technology Transformation Delivery - Transformation Coach - Senior Manager
description:
**Senior Manager – Transformation Office – Transformation Coach**

*Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from technology*

**Practice:** Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network

**Areas of Work:** Transformation Management, Transformation Coaching, Value Realization, Agentic AI

**Level:** Senior Manager (Level 6\)

**Location:** Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**


Are you passionate about shaping the early direction of large\-scale transformation programs and building organizational muscles to sustain them? Do you excel at guiding senior leaders and cross\-functional teams to define ways of working, embed governance practices, and drive transformation with discipline and clarity?


If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation and take on a senior leadership role, guiding global clients on their most complex transformation journeys — working at the heart of our clients’ most ambitious programs to set the tone, build the foundation, and enable lasting transformation outcomes, now enhanced by the power of Agentic AI.

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**


Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, redefining business models and delivery approaches.


As a Senior Manager, you will be deployed at the critical early stages of transformation programs — shaping direction, enabling teams, and embedding the practices that make transformation stick. Here are some of the key initiatives you will drive:

* **Establishing Strategic Direction for Early\-Stage Transformation:** Partnering with senior client leadership to define transformation vision, governance frameworks, and ways of working at program inception.
* **Transformation Coaching \& Team Enablement:** Embedding alongside client teams to coach leaders and program workstreams on transformation management best practices, decision\-making structures, and accountability models.
* **Agentic AI\-Powered Transformation Management:** Identifying and deploying Agentic AI solutions within transformation programs to automate tracking, analysis, and realization of business value.

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Senior Manager who brings deep expertise in Transformation Management and a hands\-on track record as a Transformation Coach. The ideal candidate excels at working in the early, ambiguous stages of large transformation programs — helping clients shape direction, define how the program will be managed, establish ways of working, and build the governance structures needed to execute with confidence.**

**You will work closely with C\-suite stakeholders, transformation leads, and program workstream owners to coach teams, embed best practices, and apply Agentic AI to accelerate program management maturity — ensuring measurable business outcomes are governed and realized throughout the transformation lifecycle.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Transformation Coaching \& Early\-Stage Strategy Formulation**

* **Orchestrate Transformation Change**– Guide and orchestrate enterprise\-wide change across business units in close coordination with talent/HR teams, ensuring transformation approaches are shaped to client context, maturity, and archetype — enabling the organization to own and sustain the change rather than depending on externally imposed frameworks.
* **Steer Culture \& Accountability** – Embed transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement, ensuring governance is actively practiced.
* **Coach Leadership Teams** – Guide senior leaders and workstream heads on transformation management principles, enabling effective decision\-making, alignment, and disciplined execution.
* **Build Capability –** Build Transformation Management capability by enabling standard transformation orchestration guidelines, structured governance, change adoption, stakeholder alignment, and value realization to sustainably drive strategic change.

**Lead Transformation \& Value Management**

* **Set up \& Run TO** – Set up and run Transformation Management Offices (TMO) / Value Realization Offices (VRO) for large\-scale client engagements, owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end\-to\-end.
* **Value Discovery \& KPIs** – Conduct and facilitate value discovery workshops to identify business objectives, key value drivers, and measurable KPIs during the business blueprint phase. Build detailed business cases for transformation initiatives, working with business and functional leaders to track and report actual performance against targets.
* **Establish Program Governance** – Design and embed program structures including decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working (meetings, reporting, RAID, decision registers).

**Embedding Best Practices \& Sustaining Transformation**

* **Build Playbooks \& Toolkits –** Develop and institutionalize transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs tailored to client context and maturity.
* **Facilitate Health \& Risk Reviews –** Lead structured sessions to assess transformation health, identify risks, and co\-create corrective actions.

**Drive Agentic AI\-Powered Transformation**

* Apply hands\-on expertise in AI Agents and agentic architecture to automate and accelerate transformation management activities — including status tracking, risk identification, value analysis, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities within client programs where Agentic AI can meaningfully improve program governance, decision\-making, and value realization speed.
* Articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
* Stay current with the evolving landscape of AI agent frameworks and proactively recommend their application within ongoing engagements.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Client Advisory**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to C\-suite and senior technology leaders, architecting and guiding transformation journeys with authority and clarity.
* Apply a cross\-enterprise perspective spanning business and technology stakeholders, navigating ambiguity to pursue a consistent transformation vision.
* Collaborate with internal team members — business unit leaders, process owners, and IT teams — to capture feedback, align on initiatives, and manage change effectively.
* Maintain strong internal and client relationships through consistent delivery, proactive communication, and executive\-level presence.

  

**Core Skillsets**

**Transformation Coaching \& Ways of Working**

* Ability to orchestrate and steer enterprise\-wide transformation change — designing bespoke approaches tailored to client context, maturity, and archetype rather than applying generic frameworks.
* Experience designing and embedding program governance structures — decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working.
* Demonstrated ability to coach senior leaders on transformation management principles — enabling effective decision\-making, alignment, and disciplined execution across workstreams.
* Skill in embedding transparency, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement — ensuring governance is actively practiced, not just documented.
* Track record of building transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs — and facilitating structured health and risk reviews to identify execution gaps and co\-create corrective actions.

**Transformation Management \& Value Realization**

* Deep expertise in setting up and operating TMOs and VROs — owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end\-to\-end for large\-scale transformation programs.
* Strong command of KPI frameworks, value trees, business case development, and value discovery — translating business objectives into measurable performance targets.
* Prior exposure using AI to manage large transformation programs — AI\-driven dashboards, intelligent tracking, and analytics to enhance program visibility and value outcomes.

**Consulting \& Advisory**

* Strong consulting foundation — strategic analysis, program management, and C\-suite stakeholder engagement across business and technology functions.
* Facilitation skills across Design Thinking, Value Stream Mapping, and transformation roadmap sessions; trusted advisor capability to navigate ambiguity and resolve cross\-functional tensions.

**Good to Have Skills**

**Transformation Maturity Assessment**

* Familiarity with transformation maturity models and assessment frameworks used to baseline program management capability and track improvement over time.
* Experience using structured diagnostics to identify program execution risks and recommend governance remediation actions.

**Agentic AI \& AI\-Powered Delivery**

* Hands\-on experience creating and leveraging AI Agents and agentic architecture in enterprise transformation contexts.
* Demonstrated ability to identify, deploy, and articulate Agentic AI use cases within ongoing programs.
* Familiarity with leading AI agent frameworks and LLM\-powered workflow automation tools.

**Industry Depth**

**Read More About Us**

* The Rise of Forerunners
* Recent Blogs

* Master’s degree required; MBA from a Tier\-1 institution is strongly preferred.
* 12–17 years of large\-scale consulting experience, managing teams in a consulting environment or as part of an organization’s internal strategy/transformation capability.
* 5\+ years of direct experience leading or contributing to a Value Realization Office (VRO) or Transformation Management Office (TMO) for large programs.
* Demonstrated experience as a Transformation Coach on large enterprise programs — shaping early\-stage direction, defining ways of working, and embedding governance and accountability frameworks.
* Demonstrated hands\-on exposure to Agentic AI and AI agent frameworks applied within enterprise transformation or program governance contexts.
* Experience leading or managing large cross\-functional teams: planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating workshops, and developing executive\-level recommendations.
* Working knowledge of KPIs, value trees, and other relevant measures specific to large digital transformation programs.

* Ability to embed responsible business into everything — from how you serve clients to how you operate as a professional.

title: Office Admin & HR Executive
description:
**Role Overview**


Our India operation is one of the fastest\-growing parts of One Retail Group, making this an exciting opportunity to join the business at a pivotal stage of our global growth.


We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and people\-focused Office Admin \& HR Executive to become the operational backbone of our India office. This is a varied, hands\-on role that combines office management, HR administration and executive support to ensure our growing team has everything they need to perform at their best.


Working closely with the India Office Lead and partnering with colleagues across our UK and global teams, you will take ownership of the day\-to\-day running of the office while supporting the entire employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to payroll, engagement, performance processes and office operations.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys solving problems, takes ownership without being asked, and is happy switching between strategic priorities and practical day\-to\-day tasks. No two days are the same, and every task you complete will help create a professional, efficient and enjoyable workplace for our growing India team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Office Operations \& Executive Support**

* Take ownership of the smooth day\-to\-day running of the India office, ensuring a professional, organised and productive working environment.
* Act as the primary support for the India Office Lead, managing calendars, coordinating meetings, supporting priorities and assisting with operational and administrative activities.
* Manage relationships with our co\-working space provider and other external suppliers, ensuring office facilities operate efficiently and all payments are processed on time.
* Coordinate business travel, visitor management, meeting logistics and general office administration.
* Ensure the office remains fully stocked with supplies, equipment and day\-to\-day essentials, creating a welcoming environment for employees and visitors.

**People Operations \& HR Administration**

* Coordinate recruitment activities, including preparing job descriptions, liaising with recruitment partners, scheduling interviews and supporting hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
* Deliver a seamless onboarding and offboarding experience, ensuring new starters have everything they need from day one.
* Act as the first point of contact for general HR queries, providing guidance and escalating matters where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, HR systems and documentation.
* Coordinate the monthly payroll process with our third\-party payroll provider, ensuring all information is accurate and submitted on time.
* Support the implementation of performance review processes and follow up on agreed development actions.
* Assist with employee engagement initiatives, surveys and activities that help create a positive and inclusive workplace.
* Work with the UK Head Office to support training and development programmes for employees.
* Assist in maintaining HR policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with local legislation and alignment with global business standards.

**Technology, Facilities \& Administration**

* Coordinate laptop provisioning, employee IT setup and office technology requirements by working with external IT providers and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain company asset registers and ensure office equipment is tracked and managed effectively.
* Process office invoices, expense claims and purchasing requests accurately and on time.
* Organise team meetings, training sessions, company events and social activities that strengthen team engagement.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve office administration, HR processes and employee experience through better systems, organisation and automation.
* Prepare reports and analyse HR and operational data to support informed decision making.
* Handle confidential information with professionalism, discretion and integrity at all times.

**Ideal Candidate**

* At least 3 years' experience in office administration, HR administration, operations or executive support.
* Highly organised with exceptional planning and time management skills.
* Takes ownership, works proactively and enjoys solving problems before they become issues.
* Positive, adaptable and willing to support wherever needed in a growing business.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across teams and cultures.
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
* Experience coordinating payroll administration and maintaining confidential employee records.
* Confident working with Microsoft Office and business systems, with the ability to quickly learn new technology.
* Experience coordinating with external suppliers, service providers and IT partners.
* Caring, approachable and committed to creating a positive employee experience.
* Able to work independently while knowing when to escalate issues appropriately.
* Experience working within an international or fast\-growing business would be advantageous.

**Who is One Retail Group?**


One Retail Group is an international online retailer, brand owner, and marketplace specialist. Our story is humble, growing from a single product launched in 2013, we now own multiple brands in the home appliance, lifestyle and personal care categories. Our future is exciting as we strive to launch onto new platforms and expand our operations even further across the globe.


We work at pace, we learn fast, where necessary we fail fast. This role will provide you with the chance to leave your mark and make a difference to a very exciting company. We’re proud of our collaborative team and continued high standards as we work together to achieve our shared ambitious goals.

description:
**Full\-Cycle HR \& Recruitment SpecialistRemote \| Part\-Time \| Philippines or India**

CFOAF is hiring an experienced **Full\-Cycle HR \& Recruitment Specialist** to own recruiting, candidate screening, first interviews, onboarding support, and HR process coordination for our remote tax, accounting, advisory, and operations team.

This is not a passive recruiting or basic HR admin role. We are looking for someone who can fully own the hiring process, manage themselves, think critically, move quickly, follow through consistently, and help us find strong candidates without needing constant direction.

We are hiring for **two part\-time roles**:

● One recruiter based in the **Philippines**● One recruiter based in **India**

**REQUIRED:**

* Min 2 years of HR/recruiting experience
* Located in the Philippines or India
* Confirm you are available during **7:00 AM – 12:00 PM Arizona time**

**Your hourly rate: $10\-$15 per hour**

**Schedule**

This role requires availability from: **7:00 AM – 12:00 PM Arizona time**

Please confirm that you are available during this schedule before applying.

**About the Role**

The person in this role will manage the recruiting process from job post through first interview and hiring support. You will be responsible for sourcing candidates, screening applicants, conducting first interviews, organizing candidate notes, making recommendations, coordinating next steps, supporting onboarding, and assisting with performance review planning.

We need someone who is organized, resourceful, creative, assertive, analytical, and highly dependable. You should be comfortable evaluating candidate quality, identifying hiring gaps, recommending role or pay adjustments, and suggesting better platforms or sourcing strategies when current methods are not producing the right candidates.

Experience recruiting for a **tax, accounting, CPA, bookkeeping, or advisory firm** is strongly preferred.

A degree is helpful but not required. We care far more about experience, judgment, follow\-through, and results.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Manage full\-cycle recruiting from sourcing through first interview and hiring support● Source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, Facebook groups, referrals, job boards, direct outreach, and other creative channels● Write, post, refresh, and improve job ads as needed● Screen all applicants for experience, communication skills, availability, compensation expectations, technical fit, and role fit● Conduct all first interviews with qualified candidates● Prepare clear candidate summaries and recommendations for leadership● Identify strong candidates quickly and move them through the process without unnecessary delays● Coordinate interviews, follow\-ups, hiring steps, and candidate communication● Maintain organized candidate tracking, recruiting notes, and pipeline visibility● Follow up with candidates consistently and professionally● Support new hire onboarding, including documentation, onboarding steps, communication, and transition into the team● Assist with performance review planning, including timelines, reminders, documentation support, and process coordination● Help improve hiring workflows, screening questions, interview scorecards, onboarding processes, and candidate evaluation standards● Communicate clearly with leadership regarding candidate quality, pipeline status, hiring blockers, compensation concerns, and recommendations● Proactively recommend hiring adjustments, including role variations, pay ranges, job title changes, job board strategy, sourcing channels, or candidate profile changes● Research and recommend new hiring platforms or sourcing methods for the Philippines, India, and remote professional talent● Identify better ways to attract strong candidates in the Philippines or India● Own the recruiting and HR support process without needing constant reminders or step\-by\-step management

**What We Are Looking For**

The right person is:

● A strong self\-manager● Highly organized and detail\-oriented● Excellent at follow\-through● Comfortable working independently● A creative and aggressive recruiter who knows how to find talent● Confident conducting first interviews● Able to evaluate candidate quality beyond basic resume screening● Strong in judgment, discernment, and analytical thinking● Able to identify when a role, pay range, job title, or sourcing strategy needs to be adjusted● Proactive in suggesting better hiring platforms and recruiting strategies● Strong in written and verbal English communication● Professional, discreet, and trustworthy● Able to prioritize well without constant direction● Comfortable giving honest feedback about candidate quality and recruiting challenges● Resourceful when job posts are not producing the right candidates● Persistent without being careless● Process\-minded and able to improve recruiting, onboarding, and HR systems over time

**Required Experience**

● Proven recruiting or HR experience● Experience managing candidate pipelines● Experience screening candidates and conducting first interviews● Experience coordinating hiring steps and candidate communication● Strong written and verbal English communication skills● Strong judgment and ability to evaluate candidate quality● Strong analytical skills and ability to identify hiring trends, gaps, and bottlenecks● Excellent follow\-through and ownership● Ability to work independently in a remote environment● Ability to work **7:00 AM – 12:00 PM Arizona time**● Comfort using tools such as LinkedIn, Indeed, Google Sheets, Slack, email, video interviews, and applicant tracking systems or recruiting trackers

**Preferred Experience**

● Experience recruiting for tax, accounting, CPA, bookkeeping, or advisory firms● Experience recruiting remote talent in the Philippines or India● Experience hiring accountants, tax preparers, bookkeepers, admins, operations support, executive assistants, client service roles, or workflow specialists● Experience with international recruiting● Experience building or improving recruiting processes● Experience supporting new hire onboarding● Experience assisting with performance review planning or HR process coordination● Management experience is preferred but not required

Please note: this role does not currently manage a team. However, we strongly prefer someone with management\-level judgment because this person must be able to fully own the recruiting, onboarding, and HR support processes without waiting for constant direction.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means:

● Strong candidates are being sourced consistently● Candidate pipelines are organized, current, and easy for leadership to review● First interviews are completed thoughtfully and efficiently● Candidate summaries are clear, useful, and honest● Follow\-up is timely and reliable● Leadership has clear visibility into recruiting progress● Hiring bottlenecks are identified early● Job posts and sourcing methods are adjusted when needed● Role, pay, title, and platform recommendations are made proactively● Candidates are screened thoughtfully, not just passed through● New hires are onboarded in an organized and professional way● Performance review planning is supported and kept on track● The recruiting and HR process moves without constant reminders● CFOAF is able to find better talent faster

**Important Fit Note**

Please do not apply if you need constant direction, reminders, or step\-by\-step supervision.

This role requires someone who can take ownership, manage their own work, think critically, interview candidates effectively, keep the hiring process moving, and proactively recommend improvements. This is a critical leadership role that bridges field operations and client expectations.

* Guide guards during emergencies and implement evacuation protocols as needed.
  


* File detailed incident and investigation reports with photographic/log support.

* Prepare and submit weekly performance summaries and manpower deployment reports.
  


* Ensure all statutory registers (muster rolls, PF, ESI) are updated and audit\-ready.

* Good written and verbal communication (English, Hindi, and local language).
  


* Proficiency in report writing, basic computer use (MS Office, email).
  


* Knowledge of safety procedures, emergency protocols, and fire prevention.
