Step into the role of FCS People Leader \- Adverse Media Screening at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.
 

You will focus on leading a team that delivers high quality financial crime screening activities, ensuring effective identification and management of adverse media risks. The role combines strong people leadership with operational oversight to maintain regulatory compliance, drive team performance, and support informed risk\-based decisions within Barclays.
  

  

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:


* Lead and coach a team responsible for adverse media screening, ensuring high standards of quality, productivity, and regulatory compliance.
* Oversee the review and assessment of adverse media alerts, transaction monitoring outcomes, and KYC screening activities to support effective financial crime risk management.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve complex cases, provide risk guidance, and ensure timely escalation of high\-risk findings.
* Monitor team performance through quality reviews, performance metrics, and continuous coaching while fostering a culture of accountability and development.
* Drive operational excellence by implementing process improvements, strengthening controls, and ensuring adherence to AML, KYC, and financial crime policies.

Desirable skills set:


* Strong experience in Adverse Media Screening, Transaction Monitoring, KYC, AML, and Financial Crime Compliance.
* Proven leadership, experience with the ability to coach, mentor, and develop high\-performing operational teams.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making capabilities, with the ability to assess complex risk scenarios and make sound, risk\-based judgements.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication skills with the confidence to engage across business, compliance, and risk functions.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based out of Gurugram.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.


**Accountabilities**


* Identification of trends and opportunities to improve areas and develop new process and procedures through the monitoring and analysis of operation data and performance metrices.
* Management of operations for a business area and promote efficient processes, risk management and compliance initiatives to support the bank's operations.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders (including business leaders, project manager and SMEs) and external stakeholders (including vendors and service providers) to support business operations and promote alignment with the bank's objectives and SLAs.
* Management of operational professionals and provide guidance, coaching and support to improve colleagues' delivery quality.
* Management and development of KPIs to measure the effectiveness of operation functions, utilising data and technology to support the identification of areas that require improvement.
* Compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer experience.
* Creation of a safe environment for colleagues to speak up, actively and regularly encourage and solicit feedback to ensure people agenda remains focused on the right areas.
* Management of attrition by working closely with HR in implementing retention initiatives for work force.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.

* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.

* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: HR Manager
description:
Looking for an experienced HR Generalist – Manager to lead end\-to\-end HR operations with a strong emphasis on payroll processing, statutory compliance, and HRIS management. This role is ideal for a hands\-on HR professional who combines generalist breadth (employee lifecycle, policy, employee relations) with deep expertise in payroll accuracy, labour law compliance, and HR systems — particularly GreytHR.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Management:

* Own end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing for all employees, ensuring 100% accuracy and timeliness.
* Manage payroll inputs — new joiners, exits, salary revisions, attendance, leave, reimbursements, loans/advances, one time payments, and full \& final settlements.
* Reconcile payroll data with finance/accounts before disbursement; coordinate bank file uploads and salary disbursal.
* Generate and distribute payslips, Form 16, and other payroll\-related documents.
* Handle payroll\-related employee queries and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance:

* Ensure full compliance with PF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, Gratuity, and Bonus Act requirements.
* Manage timely statutory filings, challans, and returns (PF/ESI/PT monthly \& annual returns).
* Stay updated on changes in labour laws, Shops \& Establishment Act, and applicable state/central regulations; assess and implement impact on policies and payroll. Liaise with auditors, statutory bodies, and consultants for audits, inspections, and assessments.
* Maintain compliance trackers/dashboards and ensure zero\-default status across all statutory obligations.
* Ensure proper documentation and record\-keeping for compliance audits (internal and external).

HRIS / GreytHR Management:

* Serve as the primary system owner/admin for GreytHR (or equivalent HRMS) — data accuracy and process flow.
* Manage employee master data, attendance, leave, and payroll modules within the system.
* Generate HR MIS reports, payroll reports, and compliance reports from GreytHR for management review.
* Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with the vendor for upgrades, integrations, or fixes.
* Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual intervention in payroll and compliance workflows.

HR Generalist Responsibilities:

* Manage the employee lifecycle: onboarding, confirmation, transfers, exits, and full \& final settlement.
* Draft, update, and implement HR policies in line with statutory and organizational requirements.
* Support employee relations — grievance handling, disciplinary processes, and policy clarifications.
* Coordinate performance management cycles, including data tracking and reporting.
* Partner with Finance on cost\-to\-company (CTC) structuring, budgeting, and payroll cost analysis.
* Support internal/external HR audits and ensure documentation readiness at all times.

Experience: 3–5 years in HR Generalist roles, with at least 1–2 years focused on payroll and statutory compliance.

**Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of GreytHR (payroll, attendance, leave, and reporting modules) — mandatory.** 

**◦ Proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, payroll reconciliation). ◦ Familiarity with other HRMS/payroll tools is a plus.** 

Compliance Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Gratuity, Bonus Act, Shops \& Establishment Act, and other applicable labour laws.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience using GreytHR?

Work Location: In person

**Job Description – Assistant Manager / Manager – ESG, Sustainability \& ComplianceESG \| Sustainability \| EHS \| Compliance \| ISO \| Circular Economy**

**Company:** JC Global  
**Location:** **Gummidipoondi, Chennai**  
**Reporting To:** COO / Plant Head / CHRO (as applicable)

About JC Global

JC Global is a leading circular economy company engaged in manufacturing high\-quality recycled polymer granules and Polymer Pyrolysis Oil (PPO) from post\-consumer and post\-industrial plastic waste. We are committed to sustainable manufacturing, environmental stewardship, ESG excellence, and global compliance standards.

We are looking for a dynamic ESG \& Sustainability professional to drive environmental, social, governance, and statutory compliance initiatives across our manufacturing operations.

Position Summary

The Assistant Manager / Manager – ESG, Sustainability \& Compliance will be responsible for implementing and monitoring the company's ESG framework, sustainability initiatives, EHS compliance, statutory documentation, certifications, customer sustainability requirements, audit preparedness, and reporting. The role will work closely with Production, EHS, HR, Quality, Maintenance, Procurement, and Corporate teams to ensure compliance with Indian regulations and global customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities1\. ESG Strategy \& Implementation

* Implement and monitor the company's ESG roadmap.
* Drive environmental, social, and governance initiatives across all manufacturing units.
* Develop ESG KPIs and sustainability dashboards.
* Monitor ESG targets and prepare periodic management reports.
* Coordinate ESG committee meetings and maintain action trackers.

2\. Sustainability Programs

* Lead sustainability projects focused on circular economy, waste reduction, energy efficiency, water conservation, and carbon footprint reduction.
* Identify and implement resource conservation initiatives.
* Monitor waste generation, recycling efficiency, and material recovery.
* Support Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) and sustainability improvement initiatives.

3\. ESG Reporting \& Customer Requirements

* Prepare ESG reports for customers, investors, and management.
* Coordinate sustainability questionnaires from global customers.
* Maintain sustainability performance data and evidence.
* Support preparation of annual sustainability reports.
* Coordinate CDP, EcoVadis, SEDEX, and customer sustainability assessments where applicable.

4\. Environmental Compliance

* Ensure compliance with Pollution Control Board requirements.
* Coordinate Consent to Establish (CTE) and Consent to Operate (CTO) renewals.
* Monitor hazardous waste, plastic waste, EPR, and environmental records.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring reports.
* Maintain legal environmental registers.

5\. Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

* Manage EPR documentation and compliance.
* Coordinate EPR portal submissions and reconciliations.
* Maintain traceability of plastic waste procurement and recycling.
* Coordinate with recyclers, producers, and compliance agencies.

6\. Certifications \& Management Systems

Lead and maintain certification requirements for:

* ISO 9001
* ISO 14001
* ISO 45001
* IMS
* ISCC PLUS
* GRS (Global Recycled Standard)
* RecyClass (preferred)
* Zero Waste to Landfill initiatives
* Carbon accounting frameworks

Coordinate certification audits, surveillance audits, and corrective actions.

7\. Audit Management

* Prepare for customer, certification, regulatory, and investor audits.
* Maintain audit documentation and evidence.
* Track audit observations and corrective actions.
* Ensure timely closure of non\-conformities (NCs).

8\. Compliance Management

* Maintain legal compliance registers.
* Track statutory approvals, licences, and renewals.
* Coordinate with consultants and government authorities.
* Monitor compliance obligations under applicable environmental and labour regulations.

9\. EHS Coordination

* Support implementation of Environment, Health \& Safety systems.
* Conduct workplace inspections and compliance reviews.
* Coordinate risk assessments and corrective actions.
* Promote behavioural safety and environmental awareness.
* Coordinate emergency preparedness and mock drills.

10\. Carbon \& Climate Initiatives

* Collect and analyse energy, fuel, water, and emission data.
* Support greenhouse gas (GHG) inventory preparation.
* Monitor carbon footprint reduction initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for renewable energy and energy efficiency.
* Support carbon credit and decarbonization initiatives.

11\. ESG Documentation \& Data Management

* Maintain ESG dashboards and sustainability databases.
* Develop SOPs, policies, manuals, and work instructions.
* Maintain digital document management systems.
* Ensure accurate document version control and audit readiness.

12\. Training \& Awareness

* Conduct ESG, sustainability, EHS, and compliance training.
* Develop awareness campaigns and toolbox sessions.
* Promote sustainability culture throughout the organization.
* Maintain employee training records.

13\. Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with Production, HR, Quality, Procurement, Maintenance, and Finance teams.
* Liaise with certification bodies, consultants, auditors, customers, and government agencies.
* Support CSR and community sustainability initiatives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* ESG compliance score.
* Audit success rate.
* Closure of non\-conformities within target timelines.
* Certification maintenance without major observations.
* Legal compliance adherence.
* EPR reporting accuracy and timeliness.
* Carbon and energy reduction initiatives implemented.
* Water conservation achievements.
* Waste recycling efficiency.
* Training completion rate.
* Customer sustainability assessment scores.
* ESG dashboard accuracy and reporting timelines.

Desired Candidate ProfileEducation

* BE/B.Tech (Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial or related discipline) **or**
* MBA / PG Diploma in Sustainability, ESG, Environment, or Industrial Safety.

Experience

* **5–10 years** of experience in ESG, sustainability, EHS, compliance, or management systems within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in plastics, polymers, recycling, chemicals, process industries, or engineering manufacturing is preferred.

Technical Knowledge

* ESG reporting frameworks.
* Circular economy and sustainability principles.
* Environmental legislation and statutory compliance.
* Pollution Control Board regulations.
* Plastic Waste Management Rules and EPR.
* ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, IMS.

About JC Global

JC Global is a rapidly growing circular economy manufacturing company engaged in the production of recycled polymer granules and sustainable recycling solutions. We are committed to operational excellence, digital HR transformation, employee engagement, and world\-class manufacturing practices.

We are looking for a disciplined, proactive, and system\-oriented **HR \& Administration Officer** to support the HR Manager in managing daily plant HR operations, administration, workforce coordination, compliance, employee engagement, and digital HRMS processes.

Position Summary

The HR \& Administration Officer will serve as the backbone of plant HR operations, ensuring smooth workforce management, accurate attendance, shift planning, compliance documentation, HRMS data integrity, employee welfare, administration, and coordination across departments. The role requires close collaboration with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Stores, EHS, Security, and Contractors to maintain an efficient, compliant, and well\-organized manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities1\. Time Office \& Attendance Management

* Manage manual attendance for workers, staff, and contract labour.
* Verify biometric attendance with Zoho People HRMS.
* Resolve attendance discrepancies with department heads.
* Maintain attendance, overtime, absenteeism, and shift\-wise manpower reports.
* Ensure daily attendance accuracy and payroll readiness.

2\. Shift Planning \& Workforce Coordination

* Prepare and maintain shift rosters and duty schedules.

* Manage weekly offs, leave replacements, and shift changes.

6\. Visitor Management

description:
Role Description:

As Engineering Manager, you will manage a cross\-functional team of engineers implementing the content strategy for Booking.com, leading the transition of these foundations into an AI\-native model where copy agents generate copy and translations at design and code time, QA runs continuously, and changes ship and are tested across markets at once, cutting time\-to\-market and cost. You will own the guardrails that keep this trustworthy, including governance and compliance, accuracy, brand consistency, and robust evaluation of agent output. Success depends on aligning a complex set of stakeholders, from UX writers, designers, product, and engineering to localization, experimentation, legal, and senior leadership.

 **Key Job Responsibilities and Duties**


As a **Software Engineering Manager** you are responsible for managing a team of engineers and working closely with product and tech stakeholders across the track and area to ensure timely and quality delivery of the roadmap.


Important aspects of the job include:

* Inspire and develop individuals by helping create personal development plans, leveraging learning resources, and offering stretch opportunities for growth.  

Manage performance effectively by setting and reviewing clear objectives and KPIs, providing timely feedback, and collaborating closely with HR counterparts when needed.
* Ensure delivery through ownership by being proactive, collaborating with peers and stakeholders, tracking roadmap progress, and resolving or escalating blockers.
* Manage team stakeholders by clearly and regularly reporting progress and blockers to ensure transparency and alignment.  

Support recruitment and planning by participating in headcount planning and involving your team in hiring processes.
* Coach and mentor colleagues across levels by sharing your experience, knowledge, and approaches to work to improve overall performance.
* Own systems end to end by monitoring application health and performance, setting and responding to relevant metrics, and guiding junior team members in these practices.  

Reduce operational risk by applying state\-of\-the\-art tools and practices, maintaining clear documentation (e.g. runbooks, OpDocs), and improving business continuity and the bus factor.
* Improve system reliability by addressing live production issues within SLA, contributing to root cause analysis, and logging and learning from incidents via postmortems.
* Build high\-quality software by applying relevant development languages, using standard libraries and design patterns, and following testing strategies that ensure security, integrity, and quality.
* Guide architectural decisions by advising on technical solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements, and aligning improvements with the wider architectural landscape.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing improvements in processes, systems, and structures, and by applying critical thinking to evaluate and develop ideas.

 **Role Qualifications and Requirements**

**Must\-Haves:**

* 8\+ years of experience in building enterprise software products. Previous experience as a developer will be preferred
* 1\+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager (must be a dedicated management role, not a temporary caretaking assignment).
* Ability to read and understand code and apply simple design patterns to refactor code and ensure quality standard by applying testing strategies
* Maintain data security, integrity and quality by following company standards, best practices and relevant legislation.
* Ability to evaluate possible architecture solutions by taking into account the cost, business requirements, technology requirements and emerging technologies.
* Ability to describe the implications for changing an existing system or adding a new system to a specific area, by having a broad, high\-level understanding of the infrastructure and architecture of our systems.
* Ability to help grow the business and/or accelerate software development by applying engineering techniques (e.g. prototyping, spiking and vendor evaluation) and Bookings technical standards.

title: HR - People Operations
description:
#### **About the Team**



Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.


#### **About the Role**



We are seeking an experienced Manager – HR Operations \& HR Systems to lead and manage HR operations while ensuring the smooth functioning of HR systems. This role involves overseeing the day\-to\-day HR processes, ensuring data accuracy and integrity within HR systems, and implementing process improvements. The successful candidate will act as a key liaison between HR, IT, and other departments to support HR digitalization, optimize operational efficiencies, and drive impactful HR initiatives.



### **What you will do**


### **1\. Employee Lifecycle Management**


* Own and lead end\-to\-end employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, employee movements, confirmations, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, benefits administration, leave \& attendance, separations, and offboarding.
* Ensure seamless, consistent, and high\-quality employee experiences across all people processes.
* Establish and continuously improve standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to deliver operational excellence.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, IT, Legal, and Business Leaders to ensure efficient delivery of People Operations.
* Ensure timely issuance and maintenance of employment documentation, contracts, letters, statutory records, and employee records.

### **2\. People Operations Governance**


* Drive operational governance by establishing service standards, SLAs, quality controls, and compliance mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, labor laws, statutory regulations, and audit requirements across all HR operations.
* Own policy implementation and operational compliance while ensuring process consistency across the organization.
* Lead internal and external audits related to employee records, HR operations, and statutory compliance.

### **3\. HR Systems \& Digital Operations**


* Own the operational effectiveness of the organization's HR technology ecosystem, including HRMS, Payroll, Attendance, Performance Management, Learning, Survey, and other People systems.
* Partner with HR Systems and IT teams to support system implementations, enhancements, testing, integrations, and process optimization.
* Drive system adoption, data accuracy, and continuous improvements across HR platforms.
* Leverage technology to simplify employee transactions and improve operational efficiency.

### **4\. Process Excellence \& Automation**


* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify, standardize, and automate People Operations processes.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and employee experience.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives by reducing manual interventions and increasing self\-service capabilities.
* Establish operational metrics and continuously improve turnaround times and service quality.

### **5\. HR Analytics \& Operational Insights**


* Own People Operations dashboards and reporting across employee lifecycle metrics, workforce movements, service delivery, compliance, and operational performance.
* Generate actionable insights to support workforce planning and strategic decision\-making.
* Monitor operational KPIs, identify trends, and recommend process improvements.
* Present periodic operational reviews and governance updates to HR and business leadership.

### **6\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**


* Build strong partnerships with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, IT, Information Security, Legal, and external vendors to ensure seamless delivery of People Operations.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex employee lifecycle and operational issues.
* Influence stakeholders to adopt standardized processes and continuously improve service delivery.

### **7\. Team Leadership**


* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing People Operations team.
* Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, customer\-centricity, and operational excellence.
* Build capability within the team through coaching, knowledge sharing, and process documentation.
### **What you will need**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree or MBA in HR is preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in HR Operations or People Operations, with proven experience managing end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience leading People Operations teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth organizations.
* Exposure to HR technology platforms and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders in matrix organizations.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end employee lifecycle management.
* Expertise in HR operations, HR shared services, payroll coordination, benefits administration, employee documentation, and compliance.
* Sound knowledge of labor laws, statutory compliance, and HR governance.
* Strong understanding of HR systems and technology\-enabled service delivery.
* Operational Excellence and Process Optimization
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* HR Technology \& Digital Transformation
* Service Delivery \& Shared Services Management
* HR Analytics and Reporting
* Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
* Team Leadership and People Management
* Change Management
* Project \& Program Management
* Process Automation \& Continuous Improvement
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Excellent communication and stakeholder influencing skills

### **Preferred Certifications**


* SHRM\-CP/SHRM\-SCP, PHR/SPHR, or equivalent HR certification.
* Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement certification.
* Project Management certification (PMP, Prince2, Agile, or equivalent).
* Certifications in HR technology platforms are an added advantage.

title: Associate Project Engineer – LGSF
description:
**Why this role exists**


This role exists to build early\-career talent in Light Gauge Steel Framing, BIM/VDC, prefabrication, and construction technology workflows. The role is designed for freshers who are eager to learn how digital models, drawings, coordination processes, and fabrication\-ready deliverables support real construction projects.


When this role is performed well, freshers develop strong technical foundations, contribute to accurate project deliverables, support senior team members effectively, and gradually grow into independent project contributors. This role helps create a pipeline of skilled engineers who can support scalable, quality\-driven delivery across LGSF and prefab\-focused projects.

**What You Will Learn and Support**

**Project Delivery and Modeling Support**

* Support the development of accurate 3D models for Light Gauge Steel Framing using Revit, MWF/Tekla, or similar tools.
* Assist in preparing model views, shop drawings, basic schedules, and project documentation under guidance from team members.
* Learn to read architectural, structural, and engineering drawings to understand project scope and modeling requirements.
* Support project setup activities such as file organization, view creation, model cleanup, and documentation control.
* Assist in updating models and drawings based on comments, markups, RFIs, and coordination inputs.

**Coordination and Communication**

* Participate in internal coordination discussions to understand project priorities, design intent, and delivery expectations.
* Coordinate with team members to resolve basic modeling or documentation issues.
* Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly to project leads/coaches.
* Learn how BIM/VDC models support downstream teams such as fabrication, procurement, and field execution.
* Develop confidence in professional communication through project reviews and team interactions.

**Process Learning and Technical Growth**

* Learn standard BIM workflows, naming conventions, modeling standards, and quality requirements.
* Follow established SOPs, templates, and checklists to maintain consistency in deliverables.
* Explore tools such as Revit, Navisworks, ACC/Forma, Bluebeam, MWF, Tekla, Vertex BD, Dynamo, or similar platforms.
* Support basic quality checks by reviewing model accuracy, drawing completeness, and adherence to project standards.
* Build awareness of automation, data\-driven workflows, and emerging construction technologies.

**Team Collaboration and Ownership**

* Work closely with engineers and project teams to complete assigned tasks on time.
* Be open to feedback and actively improve modeling, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Maintain accountability for assigned work and ask questions early when information is unclear.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing learnings and supporting peers.
* Demonstrate curiosity, discipline, and a willingness to learn new tools and construction workflows.

**A day in this role**


The day starts by reviewing assigned tasks, project priorities, and guidance from senior team members. You work on model development, drawing updates, documentation tasks, or markups while checking project standards and references. You coordinate with teammates to clarify requirements and resolve basic issues. Time is spent learning software tools, understanding LGSF systems, reviewing drawing sets, and incorporating feedback into deliverables. As you grow, you begin supporting quality checks, coordination preparation, and workflow improvements. The day closes with progress updates, documenting open questions, and preparing the next set of project tasks.

**What You Should Bring**

* Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field.
* Fresher, or 0–1 year of experience, or strong academic/project exposure in BIM, Revit modeling, construction drawings, or prefabrication workflows.
* Basic understanding of construction drawings, building elements, and engineering documentation.
* Interest in Light Gauge Steel Framing, prefabrication, BIM/VDC, modular construction, or construction technology.
* Basic knowledge of tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, ACC/BIM 360, Bluebeam, or similar platforms.
* Willingness to learn LGSF\-related tools such as MWF, Tekla, Vertex BD, FrameCAD, or similar software.
* Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
* Attention to detail, learning mindset, and ability to follow standards and instructions.
* Interest in process improvement, automation, and emerging construction technologies.

**What Will Make Your Application Stand Out**

* Academic or internship experience in BIM modeling, CAD\-to\-BIM, Scan\-to\-BIM, construction documentation, or structural/architectural modeling.
* Exposure to Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, ACC/BIM 360, Bluebeam, Dynamo, or other BIM\-related tools.
* Basic understanding of Light Gauge Steel Framing, cold\-formed steel, prefabrication, modular construction, or DfMA concepts.
* Ability to read drawings, follow markups, and produce clean, accurate models or drawing outputs.
* Demonstrated curiosity through certifications, personal projects, training programs, or portfolio work related to BIM/VDC.
* Strong ownership mindset, willingness to learn from feedback, and interest in building a long\-term career in construction technology.

**About vConstruct:** vConstruct specializes in providing high quality Building Information Modeling, Lean Construction, Integrated Project Delivery and Software Solutions for global construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction, USA. The Software Unit for vConstruct works on many interesting problems in Construction Technology. It works across different set of software technologies such as Web Applications, Workflow Management, Analytics, Machine Learning and IoT. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com.
